scripts.build: npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: 'server', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: 'client', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
